messages:
aria-ng: Hey @dev-support — we started getting 401 invalid_api_key from the Redwood API after a deploy. Deploy pulls API key from Terraform output stored in S3 remote state. Calls used to work. Anyone seen TF output corrupt the key?

dev-support: Can you paste (sanitized) the curl you run and the terraform output snippet? No full keys, just the snippet.

aria-ng: curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \"https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/chat\" -v
terraform output redwood_api_key = \"sk_live_abc123def456\n\"

aria-ng: We suspect the newline because the string in state shows \n at the end. This value is injected into CI env via artifact.

tomas: Yep, Terraform default output wraps values in quotes and escapes newlines. Use `terraform output -raw redwood_api_key` when you want the literal secret without quotes/escaping. If you're using `terraform output` in scripts it often leaves a trailing newline or escape sequence.

infra-sre: Also check how CI/store writes the env var. Some CI steps use `echo \"$TF_OUTPUT\" > file` which can add a newline. In Buildkite/GitHub Actions you can set the env with `::set-output` or store in secrets manager to avoid formatting issues.

dev-support: Quick repro steps to confirm: 1) run `terraform output redwood_api_key` (see the quoted version). 2) run `terraform output -raw redwood_api_key` (should be unquoted, no escapes). 3) on your workstation run `printf "%s" \"$KEY\" | xxd` to see trailing bytes.

aria-ng: ran those — `xxd` shows 0a at end (newline). Using `printf` vs `echo` was the difference.

dev-support: For immediate unblock: strip newline in CI before exporting: `export REDWOOD_KEY=$(terraform output -raw redwood_api_key)` or `export REDWOOD_KEY=$(terraform output redwood_api_key | tr -d '\n')`

infra-sre: Also validate header formatting when you curl. Some proxies or SDKs accidentally prepend \"Api-Key: \" or include `Bearer ` twice. The header should look like: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...` (no extra quotes). Example 

curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/models

dev-support: If after stripping newline it still 401s, please run the curl with `-v` and redact key but include first 8 chars so support can look up the key in our backend logs (e.g., sk_live_ab12cd34). Also confirm org and project, sometimes key scoped to embeddings-only etc.

aria-ng: did the `-raw` fix in CI pipeline and redeployed — now calls succeed. Thanks! :tada:

support-bot: Created support ticket RDW-2026 for tracking. Assigned to dev-support.

dev-support: Adding internal note: common causes — terraform output quoting, CI `echo` adding newline, secret manager uploads that include JSON wrapper. Recommend updating quickstart docs to include `terraform output -raw` example and a snippet for CI exporting without newline.

aria-ng: Agreed, submitted a tiny PR to docs with the `-raw` example. Closing the loop.
